description_en: Sends a message to the Chinese mainland by using a message template
description_zh: 使用短信模板发送短信，只支持发往中国内地
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi send-message-with-template --to 8615038710000 --from Alicloud321 --template-code SMS_0000 --api-version 2018-05-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendMessageWithTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone number to which the message is sent. You must add the country code to the beginning of the mobile phone number. Example: 861503871\\.

For more information, see Dialing codes (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sms/product-overview/dialing-codes?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.0.367279cbwQFoeM)
parameters.help_zh:
接收短信号码。号码格式为：国际区号+号码。例如：861503871\\。

电话代码详情，请参见电话代码 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/short-message-service/latest/dialing-codes)
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en: The signature. To query the signature, log on to the Short Message Service (SMS) console (https://sms-intl.console.aliyun.com/overview) and navigate to the Signatures tab of the Go China page
parameters.help_zh: 发送方标识，请传入短信签名名称。您可以登录短信服务控制台 (https://sms-intl.console.aliyun.com/overview)，选择发往中国大陆 > 短信签名，在短信签名列表查看签名名称
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en: The code of the message template. To query the code, log on to the SMS console (https://sms-intl.console.aliyun.com/overview) and navigate to the Templates tab of the Go China page
parameters.help_zh: 短信模板编码。您可以登录短信服务控制台 (https://sms-intl.console.aliyun.com/overview)，选择发往中国大陆 > 短信内容，在短信内容列表查看短信模板编码
parameters.name: template_code

parameters.help_en: The value of the variable in the message template. If a variable exists in the template, the parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 短信模板变量对应的实际值。如果模板中存在变量，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: template_param

parameters.help_en: The extension code of the MO message
parameters.name: sms_up_extend_code

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the message
parameters.name: validity_period
